svg.aria-label: Our pod cell bay, 35 by 5.3 by 12 millimetres, drawn to scale against six candidate cells. Each row shows the cell from the side along the arm, from the end, and its runtime in hours at 5, 7 and 8.5 mA and in the stacked worst case. The Renata 175 mAh pack defines the bay. The 130 mAh Renata pack is slimmer but 0.7 mm taller. The 240 and 270 mAh Renata packs need a bigger bay. Two coin cells need a new protection circuit and 0.3 mm more thickness. Three coin cells and a Bose-style 45 mm pouch do not fit the 35 mm length.
svg.text: Pod cell: our Renata 175 mAh against the candidates, drawn to scale
Dashed grey = the bay today (35 mm along the arm × 5.3 thick × 12 high, shell_r1.py). Green = ours, blue = could replace it, orange = needs a bigger pod or does not fit.
Envelopes are the makers' maximum dimensions (Renata datasheets, read 2026-10-02); 1 mm = 8 px on both views. Runtime = capacity × 0.85 ÷ mean current.

g.text: Side view along the arm: length × height
pouch pack, PCM inside, no NTC
Slim option: bay +0.7 H, −0.8 T, −4 L
steel coin cells, 4.3 V, no PCM (add one)
Parked: bay +0.3 T, +0.2 H, new PCM
36.6 mm of cells before PCM + tabs
steel coin cells, 4.3 V, no PCM (add one)
Does not fit 35 mm: about +7 L
Bars: blue = mean current 5 / 7 / 8.5 mA at 85 % usable (power.py nominal); orange = stacked worst case, 10.55 mA at 75 % usable (awake 9.8 mA + LED 0.75 mA, sub-power.md).
Coin-cell runtimes use 154 / 231 mAh at the 4.3 V charge Renata rates them for; at 4.2 V they hold less (not stated). Min-capacity and end-of-life figures are in the note.
Not in the picture: Varta CP1254 and Grepow GRP1254 coins (same size, not buyable in ones), pin cells (no ~5 mm datasheet found), Adafruit 1570 100 mAh (bench only).
Sources: Renata ICP501233PA-02 V03 08/2019, ICP621333PA-01 V03 10/2019, ICP621333HPMT V01 11/2020, ICR1254 B2 V00 03.2024 (renata.com); Bose cell label via iFixit guide 202556 (2025-12-10).
